portrait: Use case: identity-preserve. Dedicated character-select close-up portrait of ADULT Dana from Ys, using the supplied model sheet as design reference. Preserve the original beautiful blue flowing hair with cyan highlights, turquoise eyes, gold ancient tiara, gold shoulder ornament, white/cyan priestess outfit. Same adult face and design as reference, premium detailed anime game menu illustration. Landscape 3:2, high resolution, actual transparent background.
